domains.name: Advanced Chart Types and Dashboard Design

exam_rules: Closed-book for multiple-choice portions. Tableau Desktop installed on the candidate's laptop is required for hands-on portions. Proctor monitors via webcam for online proctored sessions.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. Name must match Webassessor registration exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-14: Trailhead Academy exam page 'Salesforce Certified Tableau Consultant' (Register Now, Get Exam Guide, 60 questions / 105 minutes / USD 200, English), no retirement wording; tableau.com/learn/certification lists it with 'Exam details' linking here.

official_study_resources.notes: Official free and paid training paths aligned to each certification level
official_study_resources.title: Tableau Training and Tutorials

prerequisites.description: Tableau Certified Data Analyst or equivalent practical experience recommended

renewal_options: Certifications valid for 2 years. A maintenance exam is required per major Tableau release to keep the certification current.

retake_policy.notes: 30-day waiting period after a failed attempt. Full exam fee required for each retake.
